title: Prefill/decode cohorting and CUDA Graph fence protocol to ensure capture-replay correctness
creator: Liam Chen
description:
Problem: We observe rare but reproducible token-jitter and incorrect KV cache reads after CUDA Graph replay when multi-stream decodes interleave with pinned prefill work. Root cause surface points to two failure modes: (1) non-deterministic capture windows where concurrent prefill threads mutate KV cache state during graph capture, and (2) missing fencing between graph replay and subsequent stream-specific kernel launches which allows stale host->device writes to race with replayed graph kernels.

Goal: Implement a cohesive "fence protocol" and prefill/decode cohorting strategy that enforces deterministic capture snapshots and guarantees replay idempotence across streams while preserving throughput. Deliverables include: fence primitives in the runtime, a cohorting scheduler to serialize conflicting captures, extended graph signatures for validation, and integration tests/benchmarks showing no correctness regressions under heavy multistream load.
acceptance_criteria: No KV cache corruption or token misordering in stress test harness with 200 concurrent streams for 24 hours
Capture snapshots are taken only when cohort quiesce is confirmed by the fence protocol
Graph signature mismatch detection triggers safe fallback to non-graph execution without client-visible errors
End-to-end P95 latency regression < 5% for typical 1-2k token responses at target throughput
Comprehensive unit + integration tests added and green in CI (nightly matrix with CUDA 12.2/12.3)
design_notes: Introduce per-GPU 'capture epoch' counter stored in KV meta; increment on any host-side mutation that would affect capture determinism
When a thread requests graph capture, it must acquire a cohort lease: runtime returns a cohort ID and waits for an epoch-stable window before capturing
Fence primitive: host-callable cudaEvent-based fence that ensures host->device uploads complete across all streams prior to graph replay; exposed as capture_fence()/replay_fence() in runtime API
Graph signature: stable hash of (model-config, sequence-length, KV-epoch, kernel-config, pinned-allocator-state). During replay, runtime compares stored signature and rejects replay on mismatch.
Fallback: on signature mismatch or fence timeout, runtime falls back to non-graph decode path and emits diagnostic to observability channel
implementation_plan: Phase 1 (Spike, 2d): prototype capture epoch counter and cohort lease in a local branch; reproduce race in stress harness
Phase 2 (Core, 6d): implement capture_fence/replay_fence primitives; integrate cohorting into capture path; add graph signature computation
Phase 3 (Hardening, 4d): add deterministic replay checks, timeout policy, and fallback path; instrument additional metrics and logs
Phase 4 (Testing & Rollout, 3d): run 24h multistream stress test on CI infra + internal dogfood customers; staged rollout behind runtime-1.20 feature flag
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Fencing introduces extra synchronization and could affect P95 latency. Mitigation: only apply fences during capture windows; use optimistic capture and fast-path when cohort is uncontested
Risk: Graph signature computation adds overhead. Mitigation: cache signatures per compiled graph and compute incremental hash updates for minor config changes
Risk: Deadlock if cohort leases mismanaged. Mitigation: lease TTL and forced eviction path with telemetry alarm
test_plan: Unit: mock KV epoch increments and verify capture rejects inconsistent epoch
Integration: multistream harness that creates interleaved prefill+decode workloads and asserts token-order stability
Performance: compare decode throughput and latency with and without cohorting under representative workloads
Chaos: inject cudaEvent timeouts to validate fallback and observable alarms
rollout: Feature-flag behind runtime-1.20; start with 5% of traffic (internal) -> 25% -> 100% over two weeks
Monitor graph_signature_mismatch_count and fallback_to_non_graph_count during rollout; abort at sustained >0.1% for production traffic
Run A/B latency/quality check and notify infra on anomalies
updates: 2025-01-16: Spike completed; reproduced race locally with harness (see PR notes). Found root cause: host-side KV metadata update that wasn't fenced before capture.
2025-01-21: Implemented capture epoch counter and cohort lease prototype. Initial microbench shows +2% p95 when cohort contested.
2025-01-28: Added graph signature and simple replay mismatch path. Began adding instrumentation metrics to CI image.

2025-02-03: Integration tests (multi-stream harness) show stable token ordering for 6h. Still observing occasional signature mismatches in mixed-quantization workloads; investigating incremental-hash approach.
2025-02-06: Implemented fallback path that routes to non-graph decode and emits debug bundle. Preparing for internal 5% rollout behind feature flag next week.
